title: Shifted global sections continuity colimit map
statement: For a sheaf of commutative condensed rings Λ, a quasi-compact and quasi-separated scheme X, a small filtered category I, and a diagram D : I ⥤ CochainComplex of Λ_X-module sheaves whose homology vanishes below a, for every integers s and q the colimit map induced by the shifted truncated cocone under Q ⋙ (condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙ DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q is an isomorphism.

source.place: Lemma 5.3(1), shifted or representative comparison step

proof.text: Use the shift commutation of Q and the right derived functor from [lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], followed by the standard homology shiftIso, to identify shiftFunctor s ⋙ Q ⋙ RF ⋙ H^q with Q ⋙ RF ⋙ H^(s+q). The functor naturality of the canonical continuity comparison conjugates its map by this natural isomorphism. Apply the corresponding unshifted continuity theorem of [lem-weil-pbc-condensed-qcqs-pushforward-continuity] at s+q. Its isomorphism makes the image of the continuity cocone a colimit; IsFiltered.isConnected and isIso_colimMap_ι give precisely the assertion about its legs.

proof_origin.place: Lemma 5.3(1), formal comparison compatibility; D4 uses generic shift and exact-colimit APIs

theorem condensed_qcqs_globalSections_continuity_shift_colimMap
    (Λ : Sheaf (coherentTopology Profinite.{u}) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
    [MonObj Λ] [IsCommMonObj Λ]
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    {I : Type (u + 1)} [SmallCategory I] [IsFiltered I]
    (D : I ⥤ CochainComplex
      (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})
        (condensedRingObj Λ X)) ℤ)
    (a : ℤ) (ha : ∀ (i : I) (n : ℤ), n < a → IsZero ((D.obj i).homology n))
    (s q : ℤ) :
    IsIso (colimMap (((DerivedCategory.Q ⋙ (condensedModuleSections Λ X).rightDerivedFunctor ⋙
      DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor _ q).mapCocone
        ((shiftFunctor _ s).mapCocone (condensedContinuityCocone D a))).ι))
